purpose: Chinese search reference evaluation on versioned development datasets
notes: B4 inherits non-Han engine results and keeps eligible primary order; fragment recall is an in-memory reference.
B4 reference processing timing excludes engine HTTP and tokenizer preparation; it is not an end-to-end comparison.
The report includes metrics, identities and ID/rank results. Input texts are versioned separately in datasets/. Credentials and local paths are excluded.
